chunks_used.title: High-value items
chunks_used.text: Claims for items worth more than ₹10,000 are handled by the Priority Resolution team. The support agent must create a ticket and hand over; the agent cannot approve these claims.

chunks_used.title: Opening
chunks_used.text: Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.

chunks_used.title: Voice replies
chunks_used.text: When replying by voice, keep it to two or three short sentences. Say dates with the month name ("the 24th of October"), read order IDs in groups of four digits, and say amounts in rupees ("forty-nine rupees").

chunks_used.title: When to hand over to a human
chunks_used.text:
Hand over at once when any of these is true:

1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.**
2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.**
3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.**
4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.**
5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.**
6. **Customer asks for a human agent.**
7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.**

For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.

chunks_used.title: What to do first
chunks_used.text: Create a ticket with `create_ticket` before handing over. Tell the customer a human colleague will contact them, and never promise an outcome, amount or time beyond what a policy states.

| Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` |

chunks_retrieved.title: Smartwatch not syncing
chunks_retrieved.text:
1. Make sure the companion app has Bluetooth and location permission.
2. Restart the watch and the phone.
3. Unpair the watch in the app and pair it again.

chunks_retrieved.title: Delivered but not received
chunks_retrieved.text: If an order shows Delivered but the customer has not received it, check with family, neighbours or the building security, then report it within 48 hours as a missing item under DWM-1.

chunks_retrieved.title: High-value items
chunks_retrieved.text: Claims for items worth more than ₹10,000 are handled by the Priority Resolution team. The support agent must create a ticket and hand over; the agent cannot approve these claims.

chunks_retrieved.title: Reporting window
chunks_retrieved.text: Report a damaged, defective, expired, wrong or missing item within **48 hours of delivery**, with photos of the item and the packaging. This applies to every category, including grocery and other non-returnable items.

chunks_retrieved.title: Refund reference number
chunks_retrieved.text: Every initiated refund has a refund reference number (RRN) that the customer's bank can trace. Share it when a customer says the money has not arrived.

chunks_retrieved.title: Can I return something I bought?
chunks_retrieved.text: Most items can be returned within the return window. Some items, like grocery, cannot be returned.
